mod.name: Production Tuner
mod.description: Provides sliders for working speeds, throughput, hydraulics and capacities across all equipment, tools, and vehicles.
Automatically matches downstream equipment (hog pan, wave table, separator, trailers) to the bucket size.
config.group1_handtools.shovel_fillspeed: Increases how much material each shovel strike scoops up.
Maximum holding volume of the bucket.
Maximum holding volume of the hog pan (scales with bucket).
config.group1_handtools.mobilewashplant_: Processing speed of the mobile wash plant.
Maximum hopper capacity of the mobile wash plant.
config.group2_vehicles.excavator_digspee: Dirt payload capacity of excavator buckets when digging.
config.group2_vehicles.excavator_armspee: Hydraulic speed when lifting, lowering, and extending boom and dipper stick.
config.group2_vehicles.excavator_turrets: Swing and rotation speed of the cabin and upper carriage.
config.group2_vehicles.excavator_buckets: Hydraulic curl and dump speed of the excavator bucket.
config.group2_vehicles.wheelloader_loads: How fast the wheel loader scoops, lifts, and dumps material.
config.group2_vehicles.backhoeloader_loa: How fast the backhoe loader scoops and dumps material.
config.group2_vehicles.dumptruck_capacit: Maximum load capacity of the dump truck bed.
config.group2_vehicles.frankenstein_capa: Hopper buffer capacity of the Frankenstein mobile conveyor.
config.group2_vehicles.frankenstein_spee: Transport throughput speed of the Frankenstein mobile conveyor.
config.group2_vehicles.cordylus_capacity: Hopper buffer capacity of the Cordylus mobile conveyor.
config.group2_vehicles.cordylus_speed.de: Transport throughput speed of the Cordylus mobile conveyor.
config.group3_washplantmodules.hopper_ca: Material holding capacity of the main feeder hopper.
config.group3_washplantmodules.conveyorb: Material volume per bucket on the elevator conveyor.
config.group3_washplantmodules.washplant: Holding capacity of the trommel and shaker (Derocker, Glacier Creek, etc.).
Washing speed of the trommel and shaker.
config.group3_washplantmodules.sluicebox: Dirt volume capacity of all wash plant sluice boxes.
config.group3_washplantmodules.minersmos: Dirt holding capacity of miner's moss mats before cleanup.
config.group4_fineprocessing.nuggetator_: Washing speed when cleaning dirty miner's moss mats.
config.group4_fineprocessing.magnetitese: Processing speed when separating magnetite from gold.
Hopper capacity of the magnetite separator.
config.group4_fineprocessing.wavetable_s: Separation speed on the wave table.
config.group4_fineprocessing.wavetable_c: Material volume capacity on the wave table.
config.group5_trailers.magnetitetrailer_: Payload capacity of the magnetite trailer.
config.group5_trailers.fueltrailer_capac: Fuel capacity and refueling flow rate of the mobile fuel tanker.
log.ready: Production Tuner loaded. Open the Mod Menu to adjust multipliers.
log.disabled: Production Tuner disabled. Original game values restored.
